Stage.LogText: {=sp_gt3_s1_log}Calradia's obstacles have been cleared in blood. Travel to {TunekSehri_Link} to meet the Blind Master {KorUsta_Link}, founder of the Shadow Roost, and choose the ultimate fate of the realm.
{=sp_gt3_s2_kirikkukla_log}You set the roost ablaze! {KorUsta_Link}'s 40 fanatic guards {FanatikMuhafizlar_Link} surround you in fury. Annihilate them and break the chains of the cult!

{=sp_gt3_s_bas_efendi_log}The Blind Master's breath ceased under your fingers. The Shadow Master Ring now gleams upon your hand. While Calradia's kings sit pompously upon their thrones, each morning they will wake to a raven feather beneath their pillow—reminding them who truly rules Calradia from the dark.

{=sp_gt3_s_kirik_kukla_log}As the Shadow Roost collapsed in flames, you walked away without looking back. The ciphers turned to ash, the masters perished. Now, bound to no cult and no crown, you wander the Calradian plains as a feared ghost whose name is only whispered in terror.

{=sp_gt3_s_kaos_log}That very night, false pigeons cooed inside imperial palaces. By morning, empires declared war upon one another. Cities fell to siege, villages burned, and across this continental inferno, you hold the gold and armies to tear down dynasties as you please.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_gt3_dlg1_p}I have come to face the master of the roost.

{=sp_gt3_dlg1}Step forward, little pigeon... I cannot see your eyes, but I hear the rhythm of your stride. The blood of Dost, the scent of burning ledgers, and the cold steel of ambition clinging to your mantle.

{=sp_gt3_dlg1}Step forward, little pigeon... I cannot see your eyes, but I hear the rhythm of your stride. The blood of Dost, the scent of burning ledgers, and the cold steel of ambition clinging to your mantle.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p1_inq}So you are the Blind Master—the hidden phantom who birthed the Scavenger Pigeons from the shadows.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p1_angry}Breathe that scent deeply, old man. It is the butcher's bill for your decades of conspiracy and deceit.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p1_prag}I didn't scale this fortress for poetic metaphors. Dost is dead, and the master ciphers are mine. What is your will?
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_philosophy}Deceit? No, little bird... Harmony! Calradia's monarchs are vain beasts who would drown this continent in blood for a patch of barren soil. The Shadow Roost gives their bloodlust a script. We whisper, we forge, we harvest their gold, and in return, we keep humanity from self-annihilation.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p2_critique}You speak of harmony while you orchestrated fake wars, burned frontier settlements, and starved loyal clans!
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p2_future}And now that the script has failed and your greatest puppet lies slain on the battlefield, what becomes of this roost?
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_three_paths}Now comes the anvil of destiny. The throne of the Roost is empty. You can claim the Shadow Master Ring and guide the realm from behind the curtain; you can burn this nest to ashes and walk away as an unchained ghost; or you can loose the forged decrees and watch three empires tear each other to shreds!
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p3_throne}Kings on thrones are easy to unseat, but the unseen puppeteer rules forever.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p3_burn}Every brick of this roost was laid with innocent blood. It deserves nothing but flame.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p3_fire}Why settle for ruling shadows when the entire world can be engulfed in glorious fire?
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_final_prompt}Speak your verdict, little pigeon. Calradia's crowns tremble in silence for your choice.
{=sp_gt3_dlg2}You forgot the first rule you taught me, Master: 'The sharpest beak cracks the oldest roost.' From now on, I give the orders! (Poison the Blind Master & Claim the Shadow Throne)
{=sp_gt3_dlg3}You are no mastermind; you are a sewer rat lurking in the dark! No motherland, no honor—only lies and slaughter. This roost burns tonight! (Torch the Roost & Slaughter the Fanatics)

{=sp_gt3_dlg4}The world does not seek order, Master. The world hungers for fire! I have dispatched the forged decrees to the monarchs of Calradia. At dawn, war horns shall sound! (Unleash Continental War)
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
